maturity: About five weeks of history and 5 closed trades: a health check, not a verdict on the strategy.
headline: The ramp is on schedule: today's orders were all placed, and the only real risk is an unhedged BSE put, not the shares.

points.label: Market and flow
points.text: 7 fresh 52-week-high entries, 4 add-ons and 2 exits today, with every one already ordered for tomorrow's open (none missed, KODYTECH excluded as yesterday's signal). Breakouts are still appearing at a steady pace, so deployment (₹2.0L, 10% of base) keeps rising by design. No action.

points.label: Versus the backtest
points.text: Combined P&L is +₹3.9k (+0.2% of ₹20L) and the book is 57% in profit (60 of 106). The backtest reference is −15.4% max drawdown, profit factor 2.01 and winners that run about 100 days. At 5 weeks and 5 closed trades none of these can be tested yet. Watch profit factor and average winner once 30 trades have closed.

points.label: Money leak: BSE options
points.text: BSE has two short 3200PE / 3500PE legs (400 qty) but a hedge on only 200 qty, so 200 qty of put is unhedged, and the BSE call is on a stock whose Supertrend is now green. Today's check found no other stop or hedge problems; all 13 shorts carry a stop and a target. Fix BSE first: buy the missing put hedge or close the 3200PE.

points.label: Flipped call
points.text: SHRIRAMFIN 1120CE and BSE 4200CE are short calls on stocks whose Supertrend is green. Both are small (−₹454 and +₹1,020), so the rule says close them. Leaving them costs little today but gives up the bull-put structure the rule wants.

points.label: Check before the open
points.text: SHRINGARMS: the backtester says exit (red) but a Yahoo recompute says green, and today's 1-share add-on has just filled. The pending sell is for 4 of 5 shares, so it would leave 1 share behind. PASHUPATI (−31%) carries a Dhan cost of 0, so its loss is unreliable until you confirm the split shares were credited.

points.label: Advice follow-up
points.text: Last advice, place the exits, add-ons and entries, was followed: all 12 orders are pending and 13 earlier buys filled this morning. That advice is closed. Make no rule change before 30 closed trades.

action: Before the open, fix the BSE put hedge and close the two flipped calls in the Dhan app, and confirm the SHRINGARMS sell quantity (4 vs 5).
